title: The emergence of the Cauchy horizon from the crease for $3D$ compressible Euler flow
summary: We study open sets of nearly plane symmetric data for the $3D$ compressible Euler equations with dynamic entropy and non-trivial vorticity. In our prior work, we proved that the solutions develop a gradient singularity along a singular boundary, which is a hypersurface that emanates from a co-dimension 2, spacelike submanifold called the crease. In the present paper, we prove that a null hypersurface, called a Cauchy horizon, emanates from the crease, and propagates in a direction transverse to the singular boundary.
